Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Harvest

An enclosure where rare plants and fungi grow in a controlled climate.

Fruit of Restoration. One plant here bears three magic fruits. A creature that eats one gains the benefit of a Lesser Restoration spell. A fruit loses its magic if not eaten within 24 hours of being picked. The plant regrows all picked fruits daily at dawn, and it dies if transplanted.

Harvest Options. When you issue the Harvest order to this facility, choose one of the following.

Harvest: Healing Herbs. The hireling makes a Potion of Healing (Greater) from healing herbs in 7 days, at no cost.

Harvest: Poison. The hireling extracts one application of Assassin's Blood, Malice, Pale Tincture, or Truth Serum (your choice) in 7 days, at no cost; it can be kept in a vial.
